AIFDE-V2-U001.title: Baseline, scope and ownership
AIFDE-V2-U001.primary_task: Inspect the minimal starter; attempt a small Python transform and SQL query if a runtime is available, otherwise record the unavailable environment as a baseline finding; choose the smallest useful public/synthetic-document workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Record actual attempts and unknowns without marking prior SWE experience as new curriculum completion.
Name one user, one workflow, a non-AI baseline, one measurable prototype objective and explicit non-goals.
Explain the intended starter request path from code; execution and an actual code-change check occur after the environment is available, not falsely before setup.
AIFDE-V2-U001.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U002.title: Reproducible environment and real-model feasibility
AIFDE-V2-U002.primary_task: Lock the Python project environment; create safe configuration; measure available CPU/RAM/disk; verify a no-service-fee real local generation and embedding route against official distribution/license information.
acceptance_criteria: A clean environment runs a basic test and the starter request path; no key or private data is committed. Record a blocker rather than claiming execution if unavailable.
Record machine measurements, model/runtime candidates, download size/license and expected limitations; exact versions are resolved at implementation.
If inference cannot run within available hardware/permissions, record a blocker and the specific approval/access needed; no mock pass.
AIFDE-V2-U002.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U003.title: Python data contracts and tests
AIFDE-V2-U003.primary_task: Implement typed request/document records, a small plain-text/Markdown ingestion function and meaningful error handling; use tests rather than re-learning all programming basics. From the first read, constrain ingestion to the owned fixture directory; default raw-content logging off.
acceptance_criteria: Parse the permitted small fixture format and reject malformed/empty inputs.
Demonstrate one exception path and test one boundary case.
Make one small input-format change without copying a finished solution.
AIFDE-V2-U003.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U004.title: Small API with observable failure paths
AIFDE-V2-U004.primary_task: Implement /health and a document-metadata endpoint in one Python API stack; connect input validation, request IDs and structured errors. Bind to loopback only by default; enforce fixture-directory scope and keep raw-content logging off from the start.
acceptance_criteria: Success, invalid-input and not-found requests return the documented status/body.
A request ID connects response to a log entry without secrets.
Explain the request path and why this stack is sufficient; no framework collection.
Default API binding is loopback-only; a filename/path cannot escape the owned fixture directory, and raw document/prompt logging is off.
AIFDE-V2-U004.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U005.title: Understand inference and install a real runtime
AIFDE-V2-U005.primary_task: Learn token/context/output-limit basics and the difference between generation, embeddings and retrieval; install/configure the selected real local model runtime and a narrow provider adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Model identifier/revision, license, quantization, context and output limits are recorded where available.
Adapter accepts a prompt and exposes explicit timeout/error behavior; credentials, if ever authorized, remain outside code.
Explain why an extractive/template answer and a mocked provider are not generative inference.
AIFDE-V2-U005.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U006.title: First real generated response
AIFDE-V2-U006.primary_task: Call the actual pretrained generative model through the adapter on three simple tasks; capture real outputs, elapsed time and failures; tune only output/context limits for the machine.
acceptance_criteria: At least one non-canned generated response is produced by the recorded real model, not a test double.
Record hardware, request settings, actual timing and actual token counts if exposed; otherwise mark counts unavailable.
A forced timeout/unavailable runtime is handled honestly; failed inference keeps the capability gate blocked.
AIFDE-V2-U006.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U007.title: Reality check and first evidence note
AIFDE-V2-U007.primary_task: Run a five-prompt capability smoke set including an impossible/unanswerable request; inspect failures and confirm what the model can and cannot support in this prototype.
acceptance_criteria: All five actual outcomes are saved, including failure or uncertainty.
Distinguish a plausible response from a verified answer.
Decide whether the local model is viable for the narrow corpus; do not hide a hardware/quality blocker.
AIFDE-V2-U007.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U008.title: Real generation behind the API
AIFDE-V2-U008.primary_task: Implement a /generate request path using the real adapter with a bounded request deadline and client cancellation/error behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A real HTTP request returns actual model output.
Invalid input, timeout and unavailable provider paths are tested.
Separate deterministic mocked unit tests from the real-model integration receipt.
AIFDE-V2-U008.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U009.title: Thin React workflow
AIFDE-V2-U009.primary_task: Use existing React/TypeScript skills to build a minimal question/answer screen with loading, empty, cancel/error and result states; avoid visual-polish work unrelated to the workflow.
acceptance_criteria: The UI calls the real backend and shows a real generated answer.
A failed/canceled request cannot leave the UI falsely showing success.
Explain the frontend/backend contract and one accessible error-state choice.
AIFDE-V2-U009.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U010.title: Structured output without trusting it
AIFDE-V2-U010.primary_task: Define an answer schema, validate actual model output, and implement one bounded repair/retry or explicit failure path; compare success and malformed output.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed or missing fields are rejected rather than silently coerced into a valid answer.
Retries are capped and observable; failure is still possible.
Explain that schema validity does not establish factual correctness.
AIFDE-V2-U010.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

AIFDE-V2-U011.title: Versioned small corpus and SQL metadata
AIFDE-V2-U011.primary_task: Create or use ten licensed public/synthetic Markdown/text documents (roughly 150–300 words each); persist IDs, source, content hash and version in SQLite with idempotent ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: Reingesting unchanged input does not duplicate documents.
A changed document produces the intended version/update behavior.
Run and explain a SQL query that joins or aggregates document/ingestion metadata; record licensing/source.
AIFDE-V2-U011.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

gate_rule: All source acceptance criteria and prerequisites preserved verbatim in unit_gate_contracts. Reading, scaffold generation, mocks and elapsed calendar days do not establish learner completion. U011 is only started by Day14; full local release is not due in Sprint 1.
